files.snapshot.sqlite3: One consistent, unmodified SQLite backup of the complete raw experiment; includes excluded reps2/3 and history. Filter CSV job/attempt IDs when querying.
files.inputs.sqlite3: Self-contained frozen inputs and acquisition witnesses; table inputs columns instance_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, block_side INTEGER, board_side INTEGER, input_payload BLOB, input_sha256 TEXT, input_canonical_sha256 TEXT, witness_payload BLOB, witness_sha256 TEXT, witness_canonical_sha256 TEXT. Hashes cover exact BLOB bytes; canonical hashes cover compact sorted UTF8 n/grid JSON with LF.
files.results.csv: Exact expanded CSV_FIELDS followed by session_id,profile,workers,timing_policy; 110000 primary rep1 rows including the declared ERROR. Empty cells are null, baseline encoding is empty. No diagnosticretry rows.
files.instances.jsonl: 16000 exact frozen dataset manifest records; locate input/witness bytes in inputs.sqlite3 by instance_id, not by the original input_file path.
files.profiles.json: DIRECT mapping session_id to profile metadata including profile,workers,timing_policy and source_session_manifest/path/hash. Workers belong to each actual session; sequential and concurrent sessions remain separate.
files.source-manifest.json: Original experiment.json bytes, unchanged; original repetitions=3 and planned330000 remain historical scientific metadata.
files.evidence/: Pinned root completion, declared-error acknowledgement, diagnosticretry and recovery audit receipts; diagnosticretry is evidence only, not an observation replacement.
files.session-manifests/: Original selected-session manifest and authorization evidence bytes.
files.CONTRACT.json: A byte copy of this contract, pinned in snapshot receipt.

solution_ref.lookup: SELECT payload,sha256,checker_json FROM solutions WHERE attempt_id=?
solution_ref.parameter: UUID4 attempt_id from CSV; never evaluate SQL from a reference
solution_ref.validation: Require exact ref/attempt identity, BLOB SHA256 equal solution_sha256 and stored sha256, canonical n/grid bytes, matching n and an independent Sudoku/original-clue check. TIMEOUT and ERROR have empty solution_ref/solution_sha256.

input_lookup.validation: Verify input/witness BLOB hashes, canonical hashes and dimensions against instances.jsonl; check the witness and every SAT solution independently.

snapshot_receipt.files_sha256: Relative path -> SHA256 of EVERY other snapshot file; snapshot.json excludes itself. External receipt hash is in the producer return/HANDOFF.json.

timing_policy: Separate by actual session/profile/workers. One repetition; no median3 or repeatability claim. TIMEOUT is censored with nullable observed runtime, never imputed 10. ERROR is preserved as guard/infrastructure failure, not TIMEOUT/UNSAT/cleanup failure. No automatic pooling across worker counts or trial workloads.
consumer_gate: Require PASS receipt and all hashes/identities/checkers; require declared quality/error flags and exact selector. Do not use rolling first3 selector or silently omit b099/ERROR. Do not read the live DB during analysis.
